disruptions.title: Filéo, a service with reservation
disruptions.message:
1/Register on the Filéo website

To register, you can choose:

• contact the reservation center on 01 74 37 24 77 (call not surcharged).


• use our online booking platform
• download our free Android and iOS app
You will receive a confirmation within two hours of registering.

2/Book your trip

Up to one hour before departure, you can book your trip 7 days a week, 24 hours a day.

Read all the details concerning the possibilities of booking your Filéo 3 trip

/Indicate your departure and arrival stops

By indicating your departure Filéo stop and your arrival Filéo stop, you will receive a confirmation of

your reservation.

If your trip involves a connection, book trip 1 and trip 2.

4/A confirmation is sent to you

Check your confirmation reminder showing the exact time of your Filéo sent to you no later than one hour before your trip

.

5/Go to your Filéo stop 5 minutes before departure

In order to ensure that your reservation is properly taken care of, please arrive at your Filéo stop a little before the time indicated on your

reservation.

6/Getting in the vehicle

Indicate your name to the driver of the vehicle and validate your ticket

.

Attention! A single piece of luggage with “cabin” dimensions (55cm x 25 cm x 35cm and approximately 12kg) is accepted per traveller.

Travelling with Filéo every day is so easy!


More information on the Filéo service by clicking here.
